OVERALL DESIGN LANGUAGE:
- Style: Modern, minimal, clean
- Color palette: Primarily monochromatic with selective color accents (blue, green, orange)
- Photography: Mix of natural landscapes and technical/interface screenshots
- Typography: Bold headlines, clean body text, sans-serif throughout
- Buttons: Consistent pill-shaped buttons, dark primary CTA
- Layout: Generous whitespace, clear content hierarchy
- Visual rhythm: Alternating text-heavy and image-heavy sections
insights: Extreme visual rhythm established by consistent 3-column grids (benefits, blog tiles, investor cards) punctuated by 50/50 split layouts (flows, control, developers).
Monochromatic base with selective color accents (blue verified badges, colored investor card backgrounds) creates hierarchy without visual noise.
Heavy use of card components with soft shadows (0px 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.06)) and rounded corners (8px, 10px, 24px radii) unifies disparate content types.
Spatial breathing room prioritized: 64–80px vertical section padding, 20–40px internal gaps, and generous line-height (1.5) for body text.
